description: This file defines an Android activity class 'BitmapPixels' that demonstrates handling and drawing different Bitmap configurations, with utility methods for pixel manipulations and rendering sample bitmaps.

classes.name: BitmapPixels
classes.description: An Android activity class demonstrating bitmap pixel manipulation and rendering.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner class extending View, handles rendering of bitmaps and pixel data manipulation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to a custom SampleView instance.

methods.name: getR32
methods.description: Extracts the red component from a premultiplied color integer.

methods.name: getG32
methods.description: Extracts the green component from a premultiplied color integer.

methods.name: getB32
methods.description: Extracts the blue component from a premultiplied color integer.

methods.name: getA32
methods.description: Extracts the alpha component from a premultiplied color integer.

methods.name: pack8888
methods.description: Packs red, green, blue, and alpha components into an integer in ARGB order.

methods.name: pack565
methods.description: Packs R, G, B components into a 16-bit Short in 565 format.

methods.name: pack4444
methods.description: Packs R, G, B, A components into a 16-bit Short in 4444 format.

methods.name: mul255
methods.description: Multiplies a color component by alpha, with scaling.

methods.name: premultiplyColor
methods.description: Converts a color int into a premultiplied device color.

methods.name: makeRamp
methods.description: Generates color ramp data for different pixel formats between two colors.

methods.name: makeBuffer
methods.description: Creates an IntBuffer or ShortBuffer from given pixel arrays.
